records: Bitquery's statement that all drained wallets carry Binance PoR labels is a provider-attribution claim. The five XRPL source addresses have not yet been matched byte-for-byte to the official downloadable October 1 Binance PoR address file. CoinDesk's reviewed crosswalk identifies Binance 14 on Ethereum, not the five XRPL accounts. The reported October 1 XRP ratio is secondary-source context only; no post-incident XRP reserve ratio is established.

Bitquery's latest captured XRPL receiver balance cutoff is 2026-10-30 06:43 UTC. No outgoing XRP transaction was observed by that cutoff, but no receiver balance after 06:43 UTC is claimed. The exact prior five-payment sum is 233,461,943.1 XRP while Bitquery reports a rounded approximately 233.5M balance.

Binance's USD 6.34B company-resource statement, USD 5B in impacted token assets and USD 3B frozen/protected are company-reported aggregate figures. They do not prove XRP-specific replenishment, a current wallet reserve ratio, completed customer-level reconciliation or the final technical root cause. Reuters reports additional breach points and a TRM signing-infrastructure assessment; the exact authorization path and private-key status remain unresolved.
